name: Gamdom
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Crypto gambling platform Gamdom was attacked on October 13, 2026, due to an unauthorized server connection, resulting in approximately $4.2 million stolen from hot wallets. The incident affected multiple blockchains; the platform went offline for investigation and moved remaining hot wallet funds to cold storage.
